title: Transcriptomic analysis of Multiple Myeloma bone marrow microenvironment
description: We report the RNA sequencing of the non-tumoral CD138- fractions of 74 MM patient BM aspirates taken at the time of diagnosis. Overall design: The sequencing of total RNA from the non-tumoral CD138- fractions of 74 MM patient BM aspirates was performed using TruSeq Stranded mRNA Sample Preparation kit on a NextSeq 500 Illumina sequencing platform (Illumina) by 5 successive runs using NextSeq 500 High Output kit v2 (Illumina) generating in average 20 million pairs of reads per sample.
